root.label: Ohio judge renders 24 former athletes ineligible

events.label: Ohio judge renders 24 former athletes ineligible

slots.name: ineligible athletes
slots.sentence: The three-judge Kentucky appeals panel's ruling in favor of the NCAA marks the NCAA's second legal "victory" on Oct. 2, after an Ohio judge reversed course in a separate eligibility case, rendering 24 former student-athletes ineligible.
